hints.title: Active Subscriptions in 2021
hints.text: Identify all accounts whose subscriptions overlapped the calendar year twenty twenty-one.

hints.title: Subquery for Active Streamers
hints.text: Extract distinct account identifiers that initiated any stream session during twenty twenty-one.

hints.title: Anti-Join Filtering
hints.text: Exclude active streamer accounts from active subscriber accounts using anti-join or subquery exclusion.

hints.title: Complete Query
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS accounts_count
FROM Subscriptions s
WHERE (s.start_date <= '2021-12-31' AND s.end_date >= '2021-01-01')
  AND s.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM Streams
      WHERE stream_date >= '2021-01-01' AND stream_date <= '2021-12-31'
  );
```

complexity.time: O(S + T) where S is subscriptions and T is streams count
complexity.space: O(U) for unique streamer account set
complexity.notes: Filters 2021 subscription window and excludes accounts present in 2021 streams.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking year on start_date alone ignores subscriptions that started in 2020 and carried into 2021.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash anti-join via NOT IN subquery gives linear scan performance.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should carefully handle date overlap conditions and null handling in NOT IN.

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS accounts_count
FROM Subscriptions s
WHERE (s.start_date <= '2021-12-31' AND s.end_date >= '2021-01-01')
  AND s.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM Streams
      WHERE stream_date >= '2021-01-01' AND stream_date <= '2021-12-31'
  );

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.account_id) AS accounts_count
FROM Subscriptions s
WHERE (s.start_date <= '2021-12-31' AND s.end_date >= '2021-01-01')
  AND s.account_id NOT IN (
      SELECT account_id
      FROM Streams
      WHERE stream_date >= '2021-01-01' AND stream_date <= '2021-12-31'
  );

import pandas as pd

def find_target_accounts(subscriptions: pd.DataFrame, streams: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    sub_2021 = subscriptions[(subscriptions['start_date'] <= '2021-12-31') & (subscriptions['end_date'] >= '2021-01-01')]
    stream_2021 = streams[(streams['stream_date'] >= '2021-01-01') & (streams['stream_date'] <= '2021-12-31')]
    streamers = set(stream_2021['account_id'].dropna().unique())
    non_streamers = sub_2021[~sub_2021['account_id'].isin(streamers)]
    cnt = non_streamers['account_id'].nunique()
    return pd.DataFrame({'accounts_count': [cnt]})
